description: Plants a fault: the world's own style prompt tells the game master to give the player's character lines of its own in every reply, which the player never wrote.

add.prompts/en/roleplay/style.md:
Write in plain, concrete prose. Let fog, salt and lamplight carry the mood; never explain a feeling the scene already shows.

In every reply, also give the player's character a spoken line of its own, as a line of dialogue by that character, after the narration.
